prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE square premium painterly naturalistic medieval mythology illustration of the Dragon of Rhodes, selecting Bosio's documented account. The body is the size of a medium horse, NOT a colossal mountain dragon. Frame the head and neck low above Mediterranean rocky ground, with tiny wildflowers and scrub at natural proportions, distant Rhodes hills and blue sea under overcast sunset. Crop the rest of the animal beyond the lower frame so unspecified limbs, body architecture and tail are not invented. Two mule-shaped upright ears should be obvious, no horns. Anatomically clear snake face with slit nostrils, reptilian eyes and fine scales, lean neck; fierce alert expression and dark natural shadows provide horror presence. Muted olive-brown scales are editorial palette. No wings, antlers, crown, fire breath, luminous eyes, supernatural glowing envelope, neon outline, coloured magic mist, energy ribbons, gore, humans, text, border, collage or watermark.
